checks.title: Appropriate sample weight

checks.title: Analytic weights positive and non-missing
checks.message: 0 analytic records with missing/zero weight. Weighted population represented: 226.3 million.

checks.title: Design degrees of freedom
checks.message: Analytic population spans 49 PSUs in 24 strata (df = 25). NCHS flags estimates with df < 8.

checks.title: Outcome missingness
checks.message: 5.5% of the eligible population lacks the outcome (490 of 8878). Missing outcome is assumed missing at random within the design.

checks.title: Complete-case loss
checks.message: 17.3% of the analytic sample (1378) lack >=1 covariate. Multiple-imputation sensitivity analysis recommended.

checks.title: Raw values within plausible ranges
checks.message: Out-of-range values: BMXBMI (0 low, 1 high); LBXGH (1 low, 0 high)

checks.title: NCHS presentation standards for proportions
checks.message: 11 of 11 estimates meet the standard; 0 should be suppressed, 0 flagged for review.

checks.title: No implausible effect sizes
checks.message: All ratio estimates within 0.1-10 with SE(log) < 2.5.

checks.title: Model size vs design degrees of freedom
checks.message: Primary model has 16 parameters; design df = 25. Wald tests and CIs use the design df (t distribution).

checks.title: Collinearity (generalized VIF)
checks.message: Maximum VIF 8.46 (waist_per10). Consider removing/combining collinear covariates or interpreting with care.

checks.title: Sensitivity analyses agree with primary result
checks.message: 7 of 8 sensitivity analyses agree in direction (associations) or magnitude (prevalence). Divergent: Alternative exposure: Central adiposity - waist-to-height ratio >=0.5

checks.title: Age top-coding
checks.message: NHANES top-codes age at 80 years; age is modelled as continuous with this censoring.
